newsitem.title: LATVIA: Unibanka rebounds, Latvian share trade up.
newsitem.headline: Unibanka rebounds, Latvian share trade up.

text.p: Shares in leading bank Unibanka rebounded on Thursday but several secondary market shares including Kaija fish cannery slipped, Riga stock exchange said.

Unibanka rose to 2.12 lats from 1.85 lats on turnover of 25,671 lats and accounted for most of the day's 66,524 lats of business. A slide from 2.15 lats on Wednesday in Unibanka was the first setback for the share in recent trading sessions.
Riga Transport Fleet, also on the official list, traded 9,105 lats and ended one santime higher at 1.04 lats.
On the secondary list, Kaija slid to 1.07 lats from 1.25 lats on trade of 16,442 lats.
The next popular share was yeast factory Rigas Raugs, which also fell, hitting 1.64 lats after 1.92 lats and turning over 9,433 lats of stock.
Another faller was the Latvian Bridges construction group, which went down to 55 santimes from 58 on trade of 2,035 lats.
But the Daugavpils machine chain factory gained to 72 santimes from 63 santimes on business of 2,397 lats.
